issues.display_title: Issue #4415: [Copilot] Support Change Tour Type Global Modal, Slash Command, and Countly Telemetry
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Add global host modal support for change_tour_type, register the /change-type slash command, replicate existing dashboard after-success behavior (redirect to sequence page when changed to hosted_tour with panoramas), and integrate Countly telemetry.

Scope & Requirements

  1. Global Tour Action Modal Dispatch & After-Success UX:

    • Register change_tour_type in TOUR_TOOL_TARGETS in src/components/layouts/Layout.jsx.
    • Render ChangeTourType component inside GlobalTourActionModal.jsx with active tour data.
    • On success, emit gothru:tour_updated with action: 'change_tour_type'.
    • If the new tour type is hosted_tour and the tour has panoramas (total_panorama > 0), automatically navigate to /my-tours/:mid/sequence matching existing behavior in TourSummary.jsx and List.jsx.

  2. Client-Side Archive Gating:

    • Add safety guard in src/components/layouts/ChatAiSidebar/hooks/useChatAi.js to clear clientAction if the targeted tour is archived (archived === true).

  3. Slash Command Registration:

    • Add /change-type command definition ("Change Tour Type") to src/components/layouts/ChatAiSidebar/constants/slashCommands.js.

  4. Countly Telemetry:

    • Add open_modal_change_tour_type to permitted action enums in src/utils/countly.js.
    • Map composite action ('open_modal', 'change_tour_type') -> 'open_modal_change_tour_type'.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Dispatching gothru:action with target change_tour_type opens ChangeTourType modal.
  • Changing type to hosted_tour on a tour with panoramas redirects to /my-tours/:mid/sequence.
  • Mentioning an archived tour clears clientAction and does not display an invalid button.
  • Countly logs open_modal_change_tour_type for change tour type actions.
  • Slash command /change-type appears in autocomplete dropdown.
  • All frontend unit tests pass (npm test).
